grounded_candidates.title: The Airlock Sabotage

beats.label: RAE (Alarmed)
beats.text: "The airlock opened from inside!"

beats.label: CAMERA
beats.text: A red warning illuminates a control panel marked OCCUPIED as air streams into space.

beats.label: IVO (Focused)
beats.text: "Override it. The survey crew is still in there."

beats.label: RAE (Urgent)
beats.text: "Someone disabled my access. I can't close it."

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: Ivo searches the console for the command log while the oxygen indicator falls.

beats.label: IVO (Confused)
beats.text: "Only two people have clearance for that command."

beats.label: RAE (Firm)
beats.text: "We're both standing here. Check who sent it."

beats.label: SOUND FX
beats.text: The console chimes as a crew member pounds on the inner airlock window.

beats.label: IVO (Shaken)
beats.text: "The command came from your suit."

grounded_candidates.hook: An engineer discovers an airlock has been opened from the inside while a crew is trapped within.
grounded_candidates.cliffhanger: Ivo reveals that the command to open the airlock originated from Rae's own suit, implicating her in the potential murder of her colleagues.
grounded_candidates.why_it_works: The clip establishes high stakes immediately with a life-or-death situation. The mystery of the 'insider' threat creates a compelling whodunit dynamic that keeps the viewer engaged until the final accusation.
risks: The resolution in the full episode (a simulation) might feel like a letdown to viewers expecting a genuine thriller.

grounded_candidates.title: The Championship Sabotage

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: The scoreboard changed before she scored!

beats.label: CAMERA
beats.text: The ball hangs above the basket while two points appear on the visiting team's total.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: That error would decide the championship. Show the referee.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: The replay operator says the recording was deleted.

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The captain turns her phone toward a second screen showing an unedited recording.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: Keep your copy. I'll demand a review.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: There's someone entering the scoring booth on this video.

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The captain freezes the video on a jacket identical to the coach's.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: Coach, why were you in the booth?

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The coach reaches for the phone while the captain steps back.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: I was reporting the fault. The referee has already corrected the score.

grounded_candidates.hook: The scoreboard changed before she scored!
grounded_candidates.cliffhanger: I was reporting the fault. The referee has already corrected the score.
grounded_candidates.why_it_works: The clip establishes a clear conflict involving a potential cheating scandal in a high-stakes sports environment. It moves quickly from the initial observation of an error to the discovery of evidence, culminating in a direct confrontation between the captain and the coach that leaves the viewer questioning the coach's true motives.
risks: The resolution of the score correction at the end might feel like a premature answer to the mystery.
Requires the audience to quickly grasp the significance of a scoreboard error.
